verificationLimits: 200% layout reflow was checked at a 720 CSS-pixel viewport, equivalent to a 1440px viewport at 200%; an actual browser zoom setting was not used.
The script-free fallback was rendered by a local QA response that removes scripts and unwraps the exact noscript fallback. Both stories and all eight full-size image links remained available.
Reduced-motion support was checked in the parsed CSS media rule; the operating system preference was not changed.
Applicant details returned a loading error during native capture. The working job overview with the fictional pipeline count is shown instead.
